response: Ward H/E (Bandra East, Santacruz East, Khar East) has billed Rs 6145533 of its Rs 8200000 road repair budget, or 74.9 percent, across 111 jobs. Of these, 26.1 percent were reopened within 30 days and only 48.6 percent met their deadline. This is a low lying ward (index 0.75) where flooding is common, and the city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season, so some repeat damage is expected. Still, Rs 896301 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing. These bills need review. Also, 7 jobs were billed more than 30 percent above the rate card and should be checked. The top contractor by spend is Sahyadri Infra Works (synthetic). Ask the ward office for the bills behind WO25-01013 and WO25-01236, and whether either road was under DLP.
